import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { getBackendCaveNearby } from '@src/api/bot/cave-nearby-queries';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const HEADER = [
  { label: '我的灵田', command: '/灵田' },
];

const FOOTER = [
  { label: '洞府阵法', command: '/洞府阵法' },
  { label: '灵田记录', command: '/灵田记录' },
  { label: '我的好友', command: '/我的好友' }
];

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();
  const nearbyResult = await getBackendCaveNearby(bid, uid);
  const pageRows = nearbyResult.players;
  const total = pageRows.length;

  if (pageRows.length === 0) {
    md.addText(nearbyResult.message ?? '附近暂无可查看的玩家灵田。');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '附近灵田',
        header: HEADER,
        footer: FOOTER,
        content: md
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  md.addText(`附近玩家灵田（共${total}位）`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  const viewOptions: { label: string; value: string }[] = [];
  const stealOptions: { label: string; value: string }[] = [];

  pageRows.forEach((row, index) => {
    const quote = Format.createMarkdown().addText(`【${index + 1}】【${row.relationLabel}】${row.ownerName}`);

    {
      quote.addText(' ');
      quote.addButton('[查看灵田]', { data: `/查看灵田 ${row.ownerId}` });
      if (row.canSteal) {
        quote.addText(' ');
        quote.addButton('[偷药]', { data: `/偷药 ${row.ownerId}` });
      }
    }
    quote.addNewline().addText(`灵气：${row.auraText}`).addNewline().addText(`状态：${row.stolenStatusText}`);
    md.addBlockquote(quote);

    if (index < pageRows.length - 1) {
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
    }

    viewOptions.push({ label: `查看 ${row.ownerName} 的灵田`, value: `/查看灵田 ${row.ownerId}` });
    if (row.canSteal) {
      stealOptions.push({ label: `偷药 ${row.ownerName}`, value: `/偷药 ${row.ownerId}` });
    }
  });

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '附近灵田',
      header: HEADER,
      footer: FOOTER,
      content: md
    })
  );
});
